title: Our favourite tourist shop in Barcelona!
text:
My partner and me did the Beach Tour last week and the whole process felt super easy. The tour was organized really quickly and all the options got explained super well. 
At the store all the staff was very nice and helpful. We got our bikes to start the tour around Barcelona. 
The guides managed to do the interactive which made it more fun to listen to and kept us attentive.
In the end the tour even took a bit longer than announced  so all in all we are super happy to have booked our tour with Born Bike, espeacially for this price. 
Next time we will definitely try more tours at this shop :)
author: Lars-Eric H

title: Excellent tour - definitely recommend!
text: What an amazing experience! My family - including two teens - loved our cycle tour with Ernst. Amazing historical knowledge and local insights. Ernst gave us the tour in English despite not being the language he usually does the tour in (as our original guide was unavailable due to unforeseen circumstances). Ernst was very accommodating when we arrived and gave us options. We really appreciated him taking us on the tour and we are so glad he did as he was super friendly and knowledgeable. I would recommend this tour to anyone!
author: Susie_R

title: Great!
text: We visited Barceloneta beach and its surroundings with the children with Ernest who was a very nice guide and told us a lot of historical facts and curiosities about the city, with supporting photos to show us the same places in the past. Very interesting and well adapted to our pace, bike tour highly recommended!

title: A GOOD DISCOVERY
text: After a search on the internet I book with born bike.arrived there on the day of preparation given the time a little uncertain we realize we were alone we were in 7 .the owner Ernest offers him to accompany us explaining that he speaks Spanish and a little Italian we trust ... we leave to discover the Barcelona and the south of Barcelona what you would not be able to do in three days of travel as we did .Ernest turned out to be a prepared and passionate guide, pleasant flat bike ride and in total safety .Ernest has made his passion his job ITALIANS RELY ON US WE HAVE UNDERSTOOD EVERYTHING LEAR

title: Great tour at Barcelona's seaside
text: This was a great tour, with a view of Barcelona from who really lives there. A more relaxed tour outside of the usual tourist spots. Ernés, the owner, is a very helpful person who can gives you some good hints on neighborhood.
